policy.derived_only: An observation row is a derived experience record, never episode authority.
policy.append_only: Rows are only appended; a correction is a new row, not an edit of history.
policy.never_authority: The ledger never grants PASS and never replaces meta/episode-state.json or meta/story-gates.json.
policy.no_score: The ledger records levels, counts and decisions; it never records a similarity score.
policy.human_triggered: Rows are written only when a human runs the observe command, never by the production Runtime.
